reading.body:
QES Computers has no published power specification on file, no operator attribution, and coordinates that currently map to a restaurant rather than a data center facility. The research status is exhausted, meaning no reliable operator website or distinguishing identifier beyond the facility name exists in available sources. This record cannot be read as a meaningful data point about AI infrastructure capacity.

California has 103 mapped data center facilities on file, of which only 11 publish power specifications totaling 365 MW. QES Computers is ranked 12th by published MW in the state, a position it cannot legitimately occupy without a published figure. This suggests either a data entry error, a facility that was mapped but never published specifications, or an inactive record.

Without a confirmed operator, a current address, or published power capacity, this facility cannot be assessed for its role in AI scaling or grid constraint. Resolving the operator identity and confirming whether the site remains in operation would be required before any technical reading is possible.
